common_premise: Fixed R valid GameTemp/Battle/System/metadata/data records and ordinary objects; no plugin/concurrent mutation. Local branches described statically. Source FULL credit remains with each actual reader; a received callback request is not backend success.
common_cancel: Only reached branch asserted; prior parse/setup/scene/handler error may stop later work. Creation dictionary, internal rules, retained next-battle records and saved audio memory are separate state.
common_failure: Source order, no transaction or ensure rollback across parsing/preparation/scene/events. Earlier argument-rule writes and battle-field assignments can remain after later validation or consumer error.
common_persistence: Preparation fields/rules are runtime state. Pokemon and global objects may be persistent references, but this receipt does not certify serialization/reload or native media.
